detector.description: Alerts when k8s pod phase is reported pending or failed for more than 80% of time in last 5 min.
detector.name: (K8s health) K8s pod phase pending/failed within 5 min
detector.programText:
A = data('k8s.pod.phase').publish(label='A')
detect((when((A >= threshold(1)) and (A <= threshold(1)), lasting='5m', at_least=0.8)) or (when((A >= threshold(4)) and (A <= threshold(4)), lasting='5m', at_least=0.8)), auto_resolve_after='15d').publish('(K8s health) K8s pod phase pending/failed within 5 min')

rules.description: The value of k8s.pod.phase is within 1 and 1 for 80% of 5m OR The value of k8s.pod.phase is within 4 and 4 for 80% of 5m.
rules.detectLabel: (K8s health) K8s pod phase pending/failed within 5 min
